metadata.title: Geometric $C^1$-stability of geodesic spheres under volume-preserving mean curvature flow
metadata.abstract: We prove stability of geodesic spheres under volume-preserving mean curvature flow in the simply connected space forms under genuinely first-order geometric assumptions. The initial hypersurface is required to lie in a sufficiently thin annulus around a geodesic sphere and to have outward normal making a small angle with the radial direction. No convexity, mean convexity, initial curvature bound, or Hölder control of the normal is assumed. The main ingredient is a quantitative Alexandrov reflection argument that converts these initial assumptions into a strong reflection property preserved by the flow. The resulting radial and angular control allows us to derive estimates for the mean curvature and the full second fundamental form, and hence long-time existence, eventual convexity, and smooth exponential convergence to a geodesic sphere. In hyperbolic space, the eventual convexity can be strengthened to horospherical convexity. The reflection threshold also yields a quantitative estimate for the displacement of the limiting centre. For Lipschitz initial hypersurfaces, we develop a separate positive-time curvature estimate that is uniform along smooth approximations. This produces an instantaneously smooth evolution with the same eventual convexity and smooth exponential convergence.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在单连通空间形式中，仅要求初始超曲面位于测地球附近薄环带且法向与径向夹角小，证明保体积平均曲率流全时存在、最终凸并光滑指数收敛到测地球；另对 Lipschitz 初值给出正时间平滑版本。
analysis.breakthrough: 从一阶几何接近出发得到长期稳定性，免去初始凸性、平均凸性及曲率界。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。仍需足够小的环带与角度阈值；Lipschitz 情形使用单独估计，不能只套用光滑初值结论。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
